chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muʿammar ibn Khallad, who said:
I heard al-Riḍā عليه السلام, and something was mentioned, so he said: “What is your need for that? This is Abū Jaʿfar; I have seated him in my seat and placed him in my position.”
And he said: “We are a Household whose younger ones inherit from our elder ones, exactly and precisely, feather to feather.”

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, identified here as the one placed in the Imam’s position
key_terms.أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ: the Household; referring to the family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the speaker in the report
key_terms.الْقُذَّةَ بِالْقُذَّةِ: with exact correspondence and precision, feather to feather
key_terms.مَجْلِسِي: my seat; a sign of designated authority and position
key_terms.مَكَانِي: my place; indicating succession and representation
key_terms.يَتَوَارَثُ: inherit from one another; here referring to transmitted authority and knowledge

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام indicate the Imamate of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام indicating Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام as his appointed successor by seating him in his own place. It also emphasizes that the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام transmit their knowledge and authority from one generation to the next with complete exactness.
